history.name: Contents, with what moved in each area
history.description: A numbered contents list follows the front page, naming every area with how many features it holds and a dot for each one that is new or updated in this edition. The reader can see at a glance which parts of the product the release touched before reading any of it.
history.dev_notes: The .contents block; the dots reuse the same green/blue semantics as the body.
